scope_issue_assessments.detail: Linked sources also cover postoperative adhesions/hernias, rectus-sheath hematoma, upper-abdominal mimics and other differential contexts. Their full conditional anatomy and report-field integration remain unreviewed; this draft is not an exhaustive closed list.

Sonographic wall layers, graded-compression response and Doppler flow require modality-appropriate evidence. Static generic geometry does not prove dynamic compressibility, hyperemia, enhancement or tissue viability.
